body.text: Please review the details below and approve or reject this certificate signing request.

body.label: Reason (required for reject)
body.placeholder: Enter your reasoning here — required if rejecting
body.accessibilityLabel: Enter reason for your decision. Required if rejecting.

_comment_accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA: every input and action has a text label; color is not the sole signal (actions are labelled Approve/Reject, not only styled positive/destructive); contrast >= 4.5:1 using IBM Carbon g10 tokens; tab order flows top-to-bottom naturally.
_comment_callback: On Action.Submit, Teams posts: { thread_id, decision, approver: user.email, reasoning } to POST /api/approval-callback. Entra identity of the submitter is available via the Teams auth context and must be validated server-side before accepting the decision.

_comment_template_vars.san_joined: string — comma-separated SAN list, e.g. api.prod.example.com, api-internal.prod.example.com
_comment_template_vars.thread_id: string — correlation id for callback validation
_comment_template_vars.has_anomaly: boolean — true if a CN/SAN anomaly was flagged (not in CMDB, etc.)
_comment_template_vars.anomaly_message: string — human-readable anomaly description (only shown if has_anomaly=true)
